blocks.rationale: Create a joint package for the three trigger parents. One narrowly scoped helper renders both Illinois citation-only and citation-plus-value OpenExempt views from the current response contract. The other computes airline totals while requesting the four ordinal base fees as separate scalar fields, avoiding the repeatedly unresolved derived fee-array read. Both helpers retain native answer types and use only current-source facts and rules.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Apply the permitted personal-item and carry-on counts and their per-axis limits before classifying remaining bags as checked bags.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag exceeds both weight and size limits, add only the higher applicable excess fee to its ordinal checked-bag fee.
